title: Owner 2026-09-14 (via /session-handoff reason): two-tier persistent knowledge system - Tier 1 .claude/rules/PROGRAM_KNOWLEDGE.md (compressed program-wide pointers, auto-injected into every session as an unconditioned rule, grows continuously under the eager context budget) + Tier 2 docs/WORKING_KNOWLEDGE.md (living current-section knowledge, handoff-read, prune-or-promote at section close); repo files chosen as the shared loop-visible stores.

owner_approval.note: Owner embedded the directive verbatim as the /session-handoff turnover reason in the live build session and invited design advice ('if you have a better way of doing it feel free to advise'); the accepted refinements (unconditioned-rule injection under the eager budget; prune-OR-PROMOTE at section close; Markdown-pointer format; repo files as the loop-visible shared stores) are recorded in R001/R003/R004.

scope.allowed: creation and continuous maintenance of the two knowledge files by any session (append-when-discovered for Tier 1 pointers; live updates + section-close prune-or-promote for Tier 2); handoff wiring; companion sessions are consumers and contributors via the same unconditioned-rule injection
scope.prohibited: raising the eager context budget as a side effect of Tier-1 growth; carrying finished-section material in the active Tier-2 file; duplicating ledger/gate/directive state into the knowledge files (pointers only - the ledger stays authoritative); storing secrets (public repo)
